title: A Tribe Called Judah
synopsis: A mother and her five sons, each from different fathers, must come together as a family when they face a common enemy threatening their livelihood in the bustling city of Lagos.

title: Gangs of Lagos
synopsis: A group of friends from the streets of Isale Eko navigate the dangerous intersection of politics, crime, and ambition in Lagos, as their childhood bonds are tested by the ruthless pursuit of power.

title: King of Boys
synopsis: Alhaja Eniola Salami is a powerful businesswoman and philanthropist with a dark side. As she battles to maintain her political influence and criminal empire, she must confront enemies from all directions.

title: The Black Book
synopsis: A deacon goes on a rampage after his son is framed for the kidnapping of a politician's daughter. He uncovers a dangerous web of corruption that reaches the highest levels of power.

title: The Wedding Party
synopsis: The union of Dunni Coker and Dozie Onwuka brings together two very different Lagos families for a lavish and chaotic wedding celebration filled with drama, music, and culture clashes.

title: Citation
synopsis: A postgraduate student at a prestigious Nigerian university takes on the system when she reports a respected professor for sexual harassment, sparking a battle between truth and power.

title: Anikulapo
synopsis: In 17th-century Oyo Kingdom, a young cloth weaver gains a mystical bird that grants him the power to resurrect the dead, but the gift comes with dangerous consequences and moral dilemmas.

title: Sugar Rush
synopsis: Three sisters stumble upon a massive amount of cash belonging to a corrupt politician and must navigate their way through greed, corruption, and danger to keep the money and stay alive.

title: Brotherhood
synopsis: Twin brothers find themselves on opposite sides of the law — one a dedicated police officer, the other a hardened criminal — as their paths collide in a tale of loyalty and betrayal.

title: Jagun Jagun
synopsis: A young warrior on a quest for vengeance trains under a legendary but ruthless warlord who commands dark powers, only to discover that his quest will test the limits of his morality.

title: Living in Bondage: Breaking Free
synopsis: The son of the original 'Living in Bondage' protagonist follows a dark path of occult rituals and blood money in modern Lagos, continuing the legacy of Nigeria's most iconic film franchise.

title: Oloture
synopsis: A young Nigerian journalist goes undercover in the dangerous world of human trafficking, posing as a prostitute to expose the ruthless networks that prey on desperate women seeking a better life in Europe.

title: The Figurine
synopsis: Two friends discover a mythical figurine from the Araromire deity that brings seven years of good luck followed by seven years of misfortune, testing their friendship and beliefs.

title: Breath of Life
synopsis: A woman grappling with terminal illness and broken family bonds embarks on a deeply personal journey of faith, healing, and reconciliation in this emotionally stirring drama.

title: Merry Men: The Real Yoruba Demons
synopsis: Four wealthy Lagos playboys moonlight as Robin Hood-style vigilantes, stealing from corrupt politicians and giving back to the less fortunate in this action-comedy romp.

title: Eyimofe (This Is My Desire)
synopsis: Two Lagos residents — a factory technician and a hairdresser — each pursue their desperate dreams of emigrating to Europe, navigating bureaucracy, exploitation, and heartbreak.

title: Elesin Oba: The King's Horseman
synopsis: Based on Wole Soyinka's play 'Death and the King's Horseman.' When a colonial officer intervenes in a Yoruba chieftain's ritual suicide, it triggers a clash of cultures with devastating consequences.

title: Jolly Roger
synopsis: A cold-blooded hitman who wants to retire finds himself entangled in one final job that tests his resolve and puts everything he cares about at risk.

title: Funmilayo Ransome-Kuti
synopsis: The untold story of Funmilayo Ransome-Kuti, the fearless Nigerian women's rights activist and political leader who challenged colonial rule and fought for the empowerment of Nigerian women.

title: Tatu
synopsis: Three friends on a getaway trip discover an ancient evil lurking in a remote rural community, and must survive a night of terror as dark secrets unravel.

title: Ijogbon
synopsis: Four teenagers in a small Yoruba town stumble upon a bag of precious stones and must outsmart dangerous criminals and corrupt adults to keep their newfound treasure.

title: King of Thieves (Ageshinkole)
synopsis: Set in Old Oyo Empire, a notorious bandit terrorizes villages until a brave warrior rises to challenge him, leading to an epic confrontation between good and evil.

title: Swallow
synopsis: Based on Sefi Atta's novel. Set in 1980s Lagos, two female roommates are drawn into the dangerous world of drug trafficking when poverty and desperation push them to make life-altering decisions.
